title: CIVILENS Spatial Boundary Dataset Metadata Catalog

datasets.name: Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) 24 Administrative Wards
datasets.source_organization: DataMeet Municipal Spatial Data / MCGM GIS Cell
datasets.geographic_coverage: Greater Mumbai (Island City: 68.71 sq km; Suburbs: 369 sq km; Total: 437.71 sq km)
datasets.distinction_from_electoral: Contains exactly 24 administrative wards (A-T). Decoupled from the 227 electoral wards (prabhags).
datasets.known_limitations: Does not contain operational beat chowkies or road gang maintenance sections (these are internal municipal operational divisions modeled in CIVILENS as operational sub-wards with is_official=false).

datasets.name: Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation Municipal Authority Boundary
datasets.source_organization: CIVILENS Spatial Engine (Derived from 24 BMC Administrative Wards)

datasets.name: Navi Mumbai Municipal Corporation 111 Electoral Wards (Raw Reference)
datasets.source_organization: DataMeet Municipal Spatial Data / NMMC Election Branch
datasets.geographic_coverage: Navi Mumbai Municipal Corporation territory (approx. 108.5 sq km)
datasets.license: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 2.5 India (CC BY-SA 2.5 IN)
datasets.critical_caution: Identifies 111 electoral wards. Must NOT be treated as the 8 administrative ward offices. Used strictly for municipal outer boundary validation.
datasets.known_limitations: Does NOT provide administrative ward office vector boundaries.

datasets.name: Navi Mumbai Municipal Corporation Municipal Authority Boundary
datasets.source_organization: CIVILENS Spatial Engine (Derived from NMMC territory delimitation)
datasets.geographic_coverage: Municipal jurisdiction of Navi Mumbai (Belapur northwards to Digha)
datasets.license: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 2.5 India (CC BY-SA 2.5 IN)

datasets.name: Navi Mumbai Municipal Corporation 8 Divisional Ward Offices
datasets.source_organization: NMMC General Administration Department / Official Directory
datasets.format: Relational Records with Point Reference Geometries (Vector Polygons Gapped)
datasets.license: Open Government Data (OGD) / Public Administrative Directory

ward_offices.name: NMMC Kopar Khairane Ward Office (Ward E)

datasets.unresolved_gap: NMMC has not published open-access vector polygons for the 8 administrative ward offices. Boundaries must NOT be fabricated. Point-in-polygon routing operates at the municipal authority level, with ward routing using verified node centroid proximity and operational sub-ward pending configuration.
